region.dialogDesc: Define inclusion and exclusion areas directly on the live frame. Supports drawing, moving, resizing, and anchor checking.
region.rule1: 1. Uses target bounding box bottom-center point ((x1+x2)/2, y2) as test coordinate.
region.rule2: 2. MASK takes highest precedence: targets inside any MASK are always discarded.
region.rule3: 3. ROI is an allowlist: if configured, only targets inside an ROI are kept. Empty means pass all.
region.cannotSaveWithoutStream: Video stream is not live, cannot update region policy
region.freezeHint: Freeze the current frame for precise drawing
region.roiDesc: Allowlist mode: only events whose anchor point falls inside are reported; leaving it empty reports the whole frame.
region.maskDesc: Denylist mode with the highest priority: drops false positives from swaying branches, passing vehicles and similar noise.
region.judgementDesc: Region membership is decided by the bottom-center point of the target bounding box: anything inside a MASK is dropped, and when an ROI is configured the target must also fall inside an ROI to be reported.
region.resetHint: Clear every region of the current algorithm
region.cropHint: Drag on the frame to set a task-level crop window (only that area is sent to AI)
region.cropClearHint: Clear the task-level crop window (restore full-frame inference)
